stories.title: Court docs: Tiger plans to change plea in DUI case
stories.summary: Court documents show that Tiger Woods plans to change his not guilty plea in a DUI case stemming from a rollover crash in Florida.

stories.title: Reports: Balogun walks away from Everton move
stories.summary: Folarin Balogun pulled out of a move to Everton from AS Monaco after an on-again, off-again day ended without the United States striker making a transfer to the Premier League, according to multiple reports.

stories.title: Trout on 'needed' Angels sale: It's a 'fresh start'
stories.summary: Mike Trout said he was "excited" at the news of the Angels' sale to Stan Kroenke, pointing to the new owner's track record when it comes to his other teams.

stories.title: SEC chair says league 'will not budge' on NFL rule
stories.summary: Tennessee chancellor Donde Plowman told ESPN on Tuesday that the league "will not budge" on its rule that NFL players cannot return to college.

stories.title: Riley rejects critique of USC crowd: False narrative
stories.summary: Lincoln Riley responded to criticisms surrounding USC's home attendance at the Coliseum last weekend, saying he won't buy into a "false narrative."
